title: PLOT: Prompt Learning with Optimal Transport for Vision-Language Models
tldr_zh: 用 Sinkhorn OT 对齐局部视觉特征与多 prompt 集合，防止 prompt 坍缩，few-shot 识别超 CoOp
tldr_en: Sinkhorn OT aligns local visual features with multiple prompts to prevent prompt collapse, outperforming CoOp on few-shot recognition
